item.title: Regulatory R Repository fund-raising campaign
item.description:
🌟 Join Us in Advancing The Pharma Industry! 🌟
The R Consortium and R Validation Hub are excited to announce the launch of our fundraising campaign for the Regulatory R Repository!
[https://www.pharmar.org/repository/](https://www.pharmar.org/repository/)
This initiative aims to support the pharmaceutical industry's transition to using the R statistical programming language for clinical research and drug submissions.
What is the Regulatory R Repository? The Regulatory R Repository will provide a collection of validation-ready package metadata for R packages, utilizing the R Validation Hub’s {riskmetric} framework. This framework allows us to quantify package quality and support transparent, risk-based decision-making for regulatory use cases.
Why should you care? By offering this repository, we can help pharmaceutical companies save time and money by standardizing evidence gathering for individual packages and shortening the path to validation decisions.
Learn More by visiting our project landing page for more information on the project and how to donate. Become a sponsor, project champion, or project contributor today!
[https://www.pharmar.org/repository/](https://www.pharmar.org/repository/)
Let's make a difference together! 💪📊
